classifications.basis: Deterministic CSV parsing/windowing demonstrated on a public dataset; production inputs still require explicit sensor units, time and device contracts.
Versioned deterministic 15-feature schema; source axis units remain unknown and field-device behavior is untested.
Animal-disjoint holdout and grouped CV ran without detected split/preprocessing leakage, but minority-class performance is weak and no field validation exists.
Versioned prediction provenance and explicit source-relative time basis fit the current intelligence contract; scores are uncalibrated.
Uses existing Core SQLite Store adapter and round-trips held-out predictions; general concurrency guarantees were not evaluated.
Insufficient history and coverage for daily profiles or biomarker claims.
No clinical outcome labels or validated anomaly endpoints in the dataset.
No reproductive labels or outcomes; isolated from product inference.

promotion_gate: No model promotion to product from these results. Movement/features and contracts are optional reusable capabilities with input-contract and field-evaluation gates.
